title.description: The name of the word, phrase, or structure (e.g., 'adequate', 'no matter what')

pronunciation.description: Standard British/American IPA pronunciation for Vocabulary, Collocation, and Idiom between slashes (e.g., '/ˈpʌblɪk ˌrekəɡˈnɪʃən/', '/ˈædɪkwət/'). For Structure notes, always leave as empty string "" because grammatical sentence structures must not have pronunciation.

formula.description: The general grammatical formula if applicable. If none, use the word itself.

meaning_vi.description: Short explanation in Vietnamese. Markdown formatting allowed.

usage_context.description: Usage context or nuance in Vietnamese. Markdown formatting allowed.

patterns.description: List of usage patterns extracted from the input. Each pattern has its own formula, explanation, and examples.

pattern.description: The pattern label or formula (e.g., 'adequate for + N/V-ing')

meaning_vi.description: Short explanation of this pattern in Vietnamese

examples.description: General illustrative examples (not tied to a specific pattern). Max 4.

image_query.description: 3–7 plain English search words for a concrete stock photo that represents the scene or meaning (especially for Idiom, Collocation, Vocabulary). Empty string for abstract structures.
